notes: EXCLUDED FROM THE TRAINING SET on two grounds. (1) The measured analyte is CALYCOSIN, a small-molecule isoflavone co-loaded with tanshinone into a nanostructure - the results are explicitly 'CAL profiles (Figure 6A)'. The 8.22 h and 4.59 h values are that drug's circulation half-life in the carrier, and the paper's own comparison series (8.22 vs 4.59 vs 2.13 vs 0.47 h for the same drug in four different formulations) shows the label is set by the formulation, not by any peptide. (2) PEPlife2's Sequence field is not a sequence but a formulation description - 'H-r-Dmt-KF-PEG-DSPE, c(RGD)-PEG-DSPE' and 'Hr-Dmt-KF' - naming the MTP targeting peptide with its lipid-PEG anchor. The MTP peptide itself contains a D-Arg (lowercase r) and Dmt (2,6-dimethyltyrosine), neither of which survives one-letter cleaning. PEPlife2 IDs 4522 and 4523 dropped via CURATED_NOT_A_HALF_LIFE.
